items.q: I called Doctor Newman the next day and he told me to bring

ctx.x: He wanted, but that's the one thing the doctor told him. Said, alright go ahead and have it if you want to die. (LAUGHTER). But I forgot about that salt free diet. That's what Zutty had an appetite for, Chinese food. And I had that prescription filled and I gave him that medicine that night. And I called his daughter and told Alma about it. And Alma said she'd be down the next day. I called Doctor Newman the next day and he told me to bring
